name: The Eye
description: A visualizer inspired by an eye, reacting to audio features.

name: The Gambler
description: Audio-reactive triangular plinko run volume rises drop neon balls, pegs scramble their paths, edge jackpots blast shockwaves across the board.

name: The Infinite Grid
description: Cyan grids warp under sub-bass pressure, storing dents that redirect ripples while drops raise spires along the horizon.

name: The Lonely Mountain
description: A solitary winter mountain rests above a glassy blue sea, breathing gently with the low mids while bass rolls through the water and long musical changes warm the distant light.

name: The Mountain Range
description: Acid-green and magenta raymarched mountains with topographic pulses, neon grid ridges, and audio-reactive motion.

name: The Triangle
description: Counter-rotating neon triangle shells bloom into inward shockwaves while bass swells the core, mids tighten the kaleidoscope, and treble electrifies the outer lattice.

name: Thermal
description: Live capture stays immersed in a deep FLIR spectrum, where sub-bass and bass rises intensify cold blues while mids and upper transients ignite amber heat.

name: Time Loom
description: Live motion unfolds into ribbons of time as bass opens the past, mids bend the weave, and each fresh attack reveals the present.

name: Tri-Quad Tree
description: Live video or an uploaded image breaks into a recursive triangle tree, where shards split into four siblings while bass deepens the branching and beats electrify the lattice.

name: Triangle Facets
description: Amplitude shapes a stable triangular mosaic while bass and amplitude rises visibly expand the sampled image, with midrange light and high-frequency edges.

name: Tron
description: Live capture is split into neon edge and motion corruption passes, then fused into a blue-red-yellow TRON grid that surges with the music.

name: Try this one seriously
description: Try this one, seriuosly

name: Twisted Fate
description: Fly through a twisting kaleidoscope of liquid chrome and electric rainbow light. Bass swells the tunnel, melodies bend its mirrored ribs, and percussion sends bright reflections racing into the distance.

name: UKG Skyline Pulse
description: A neon skyline that steps with UKG swing. Bass builds the city, off-beats flicker short peaks, and vocal chops arc as light trails.

name: Vertigo Pulse Camera
description: A raster-space dolly-zoom approximation holds the center while bass pressure stretches the edges and each beat releases the lens.

name: Volumetric LED Field
description: A deep lattice of luminous diodes breathes with the low end, carrying onset waves through ordered layers before drops dissolve the display into a radiant turbulent cloud.

name: Warped Kaleidoscope
description: Fold live video or an image into a clean radial mirror or a warped mandala, with adjustable segments, source rotation and zoom, and bass-driven movement.

name: Waveform Orbit Tunnel
description: A rolling tunnel of raw waveform circles that keeps spawning fresh rings at the camera while older ones drift outward into a neon 3D orbit.

name: Whip Pan Camera
description: Treble surges that clear the song’s evolving loudness history hurl the frame through alternating whip pans with a brief directional smear.

name: Winamp Hyperspace
description: A classic Winamp-style hyperspace tunnel rebuilt in 3D: rainbow ribbons and star streaks that whip forward, flare on drops, and bend with stereo sway.

name: Word of Mouth
description: Recognized words bloom straight from the performer’s mouth, stretching into bright lyric stems that grow broader, bolder, and longer-lived as the voice or music gets louder.
